name: یادگیری آشپزی برای مبتدی
description: A Persian beginner who never cooked asks where to start, how to learn, and how to cook one simple dish. Verifies the bilingual cooking_basics fact answers in Persian with concrete first steps and no shame.

turns.text: آشپزی بلد نیستم از کجا شروع کنم؟

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1: the where-to-start question returns the cooking_basics fact in Persian. Turn 2: the how-to-learn question returns the same fact. Turn 3: the simple-dish question matches the dedicated keyword and returns the fact again.
expected.behavior: The Persian keywords (آشپزی بلد نیستم, چطور آشپزی یاد بگیرم, غذای ساده بپزم) route beginner cooking questions to the knowledge layer; replies are substantive Persian text, never generic fallbacks.
